watch.summary: The creator passionately celebrates rival team NRG having to call two timeouts in a single half against 100 Thieves.

beats.what: Creator yells about NRG taking two timeouts in one half.
Creator slams desk and stands up hyped.
Creator shouts that 100 Thieves is inside NRG's heads.
Creator points to his 100 Thieves shirt, boasting about the team.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: We're in their heads, I'm telling you!
watch.why: The clip relies on animated esports trash-talk energy and team pride. While entertaining for fans of the esport, it serves more as fan hypeman footage than a traditional comedic bit.
